test_title: PYST 32 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The wedding **__ring__** was passed down through generations.

options.text: She wore a diamond ring on her left hand.
He proposed with a beautiful engagement ring.
Police busted a smuggling ring in the area.
The golden ring sparkled under the lights.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**, i.e. **Police busted a smuggling ring in the area**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ring"** is a homonym, which means it has multiple meanings but the same spelling and pronunciation. (समस्वर शब्द)

 
 
• **English Meaning:** A circular band, typically made of metal, worn as an ornament or a token of marriage or betrothal.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** अंगूठी
 

 
• **Example:** She wore a diamond ring on her left hand.

 
• In the context of the correct option, **"ring"** refers to a group of people involved in criminal activities. (गैंग)

 
 
• **English Meaning:** A group or network, especially one engaging in illegal activities.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** गिरोह
 

 
• **Example:** Police uncovered a drug smuggling ring operating in the city.

 
• Hence, the homonym of the highlighted word is correctly used in Option 3.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**, i.e. **Police busted a smuggling ring in the area**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** She wore a diamond ring on her left hand. (अंगूठी)
 
 
• **Meaning:** A circular band worn as jewelry.
 
• **Example:** She bought a gold ring for her engagement.
 
 

 
• **Option 2:** He proposed with a beautiful engagement ring. (अंगूठी)
 
 
• **Meaning:** A circular band symbolizing commitment or marriage.
 
• **Example:** The engagement ring sparkled in the sunlight.
 
 

 
• **Option 4:** The golden ring sparkled under the lights. (अंगूठी)
 
 
• **Meaning:** A circular band made of gold, worn as jewelry.
 
• **Example:** The golden ring was a family heirloom.
